name: Ocypus Delta A40 ARGB CPU Air Cooler Black
shortDescription: Ocypus Delta A40 ARGB CPU Air Cooler Black (Up to 220W TDP Support / Four 6mm Copper Heat Pipes / High Performance 120mm PWM Fan / 5V 3-Pin ARGB Motherboard Sync / Intel LGA1851 & AMD AM5 Ready / 1-Year Local Warrant
descriptionHtml:
Ocypus Delta A40 ARGB CPU Air Cooler Black (Up to 220W TDP Support / Four 6mm Copper Heat Pipes / High Performance 120mm PWM Fan / 5V 3-Pin ARGB Motherboard Sync / Intel LGA1851 & AMD AM5 Ready / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Deliver exceptional thermal efficiency and sleek dark aesthetics to your PC desktop build with the Ocypus Delta A40 ARGB Air Cooler Black edition, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Engineered with four direct-touch 6mm pure copper heat pipes capable of handling up to 220W TDP thermal dissipation, this compact single-tower black CPU cooler ensures smooth thermal management under heavy gaming loads. Powered by a high-performance 120mm PWM fan capable of pushing 73 CFM airflow at up to 2000 RPM while maintaining ultra-quiet operation under 29 dB(A), it comes equipped with customizable 5V 3-pin ARGB lighting and all-metal multi-platform mounting hardware compatible with the latest Intel LGA1851/1700 and AMD AM5 sockets.
